obligations.name: missing-available-capacity
obligations.script:
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-datatypes ((R 0)) (((mkrow (decision Int) (holdA Int) (holdB Int) (paidA Int) (paidB Int) (refundA Int) (refundB Int) (knownA Int) (knownB Int) (proofA Int) (proofB Int) (booking Int)))))
(declare-const population Int)
(declare-const trade Int)
(declare-const observer Int)
(declare-const place Int)
(declare-const rows (Array Int R))
(declare-const amountA Int)
(declare-const amountB Int)
(declare-const ownA Int)
(declare-const ownB Int)
(declare-const reservedA Int)
(declare-const reservedB Int)
(declare-const deliveredA Int)
(declare-const deliveredB Int)
(declare-const spentA Int)
(declare-const spentB Int)
(define-fun localA () Bool (or (= place 0) (= place 3)))
(define-fun localB () Bool (or (= place 1) (= place 3)))
(define-fun between ((x Int)(lo Int)(hi Int)) Bool (and (<= lo x) (<= x hi)))
(assert (and (> population 0) (between trade 1 population) (between observer 1 population)
             (between place 0 3) (> amountA 0) (> amountB 0)))
(define-fun valid ((z R)) Bool
 (and
  (between (decision z) 0 3) (between (holdA z) 0 3) (between (holdB z) 0 3)
  (or (= (knownA z) 0) (and (>= (decision z) 2) (= (knownA z) (decision z))))
  (or (= (knownB z) 0) (and (>= (decision z) 2) (= (knownB z) (decision z))))
  (=> (and localA (>= (decision z) 2)) (= (knownA z) (decision z)))
  (=> (and localB (>= (decision z) 2)) (= (knownB z) (decision z)))
  (= (paidA z) (ite (= (holdA z) 2) 1 0))
  (= (paidB z) (ite (= (holdB z) 2) 1 0))
  (= (refundA z) (ite (= (holdA z) 3) 1 0))
  (= (refundB z) (ite (= (holdB z) 3) 1 0))
  (=> (= (holdA z) 2) (= (knownA z) 2)) (=> (= (holdB z) 2) (= (knownB z) 2))
  (=> (= (holdA z) 3) (= (knownA z) 3)) (=> (= (holdB z) 3) (= (knownB z) 3))
  (between (proofA z) 0 1) (between (proofB z) 0 1)
  (=> (= (proofA z) 1) (> (holdA z) 0)) (=> (= (proofB z) 1) (> (holdB z) 0))
  (=> (= (decision z) 2)
      (and (ite localA (= (holdA z) 2) (and (= (proofA z) 1) (> (holdA z) 0)))
           (ite localB (= (holdB z) 2) (and (= (proofB z) 1) (> (holdB z) 0)))))
  (or (= (booking z) 0)
      (and (= (booking z) (decision z))
           (or (and (= (booking z) 2) (= (holdA z) 2) (= (holdB z) 2))
               (and (= (booking z) 3) (= (knownA z) 3) (= (knownB z) 3)
                    (not (= (holdA z) 1)) (not (= (holdB z) 1))))))))
(define-fun before () R (select rows trade))
(assert (and (valid before) (valid (select rows observer))
                    (>= ownA reservedA) (>= ownB reservedB)
                    (>= deliveredA 0) (>= deliveredB 0) (>= spentA 0) (>= spentB 0)
                    (>= reservedA (ite (= (holdA before) 1) amountA 0))
                    (>= reservedB (ite (= (holdB before) 1) amountB 0))))
(assert (and (= (holdA before) 0) localA (= (decision before) 0)))
(define-fun after () R (mkrow (ite localA 1 (decision before)) 1 (holdB before) (paidA before) (paidB before) (refundA before) (refundB before) (knownA before) (knownB before) (proofA before) (proofB before) (booking before)))
(define-fun newOwnA () Int (- ownA 0 0))
(define-fun newReservedA () Int (+ (- reservedA (ite (= (holdA before) 1) amountA 0)) (ite (= (holdA after) 1) amountA 0)))
(define-fun newDeliveredA () Int (+ deliveredA 0))
(define-fun newSpentA () Int (+ spentA 0))
(define-fun newOwnB () Int (- ownB 0 0))
(define-fun newReservedB () Int (+ (- reservedB (ite (= (holdB before) 1) amountB 0)) (ite (= (holdB after) 1) amountB 0)))
(define-fun newDeliveredB () Int (+ deliveredB 0))
(define-fun newSpentB () Int (+ spentB 0))
(assert (not (and (valid (select (store rows trade after) observer)) (=> (>= (decision before) 2) (= (decision after) (decision before))) (>= newReservedA 0) (>= newOwnA newReservedA) (= (+ newOwnA newDeliveredA newSpentA) (+ ownA deliveredA spentA)) (=> (>= (holdA before) 2) (= (holdA after) (holdA before))) (= 0 (* amountA (- (paidA after) (paidA before)))) (>= newReservedB 0) (>= newOwnB newReservedB) (= (+ newOwnB newDeliveredB newSpentB) (+ ownB deliveredB spentB)) (=> (>= (holdB before) 2) (= (holdB after) (holdB before))) (= 0 (* amountB (- (paidB after) (paidB before)))))))
(check-sat)

obligations.script:
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-datatypes ((R 0)) (((mkrow (decision Int) (holdA Int) (holdB Int) (paidA Int) (paidB Int) (refundA Int) (refundB Int) (knownA Int) (knownB Int) (proofA Int) (proofB Int) (booking Int)))))

(declare-const ownB Int)

(declare-const reservedB Int)
(declare-const deliveredA Int)
(declare-const deliveredB Int)
(declare-const spentA Int)
(declare-const spentB Int)
(define-fun localA () Bool (or (= place 0) (= place 3)))
(define-fun localB () Bool (or (= place 1) (= place 3)))
(define-fun between ((x Int)(lo Int)(hi Int)) Bool (and (<= lo x) (<= x hi)))
(assert (and (> population 0) (between trade 1 population) (between observer 1 population)
             (between place 0 3) (> amountA 0) (> amountB 0)))
(define-fun valid ((z R)) Bool
 (and
  (between (decision z) 0 3) (between (holdA z) 0 3) (between (holdB z) 0 3)
  (or (= (knownA z) 0) (and (>= (decision z) 2) (= (knownA z) (decision z))))
  (or (= (knownB z) 0) (and (>= (decision z) 2) (= (knownB z) (decision z))))
  (=> (and localA (>= (decision z) 2)) (= (knownA z) (decision z)))
  (=> (and localB (>= (decision z) 2)) (= (knownB z) (decision z)))
  (= (paidA z) (ite (= (holdA z) 2) 1 0))
  (= (paidB z) (ite (= (holdB z) 2) 1 0))
  (= (refundA z) (ite (= (holdA z) 3) 1 0))
  (= (refundB z) (ite (= (holdB z) 3) 1 0))
  (=> (= (holdA z) 2) (= (knownA z) 2)) (=> (= (holdB z) 2) (= (knownB z) 2))
  (=> (= (holdA z) 3) (= (knownA z) 3)) (=> (= (holdB z) 3) (= (knownB z) 3))
  (between (proofA z) 0 1) (between (proofB z) 0 1)
  (=> (= (proofA z) 1) (> (holdA z) 0)) (=> (= (proofB z) 1) (> (holdB z) 0))
  (=> (= (decision z) 2)
      (and (ite localA (= (holdA z) 2) (and (= (proofA z) 1) (> (holdA z) 0)))
           (ite localB (= (holdB z) 2) (and (= (proofB z) 1) (> (holdB z) 0)))))
  (or (= (booking z) 0)
      (and (= (booking z) (decision z))
           (or (and (= (booking z) 2) (= (holdA z) 2) (= (holdB z) 2))
               (and (= (booking z) 3) (= (knownA z) 3) (= (knownB z) 3)
                    (not (= (holdA z) 1)) (not (= (holdB z) 1))))))))
(define-fun before () R (select rows trade))
(assert (and (valid before) (valid (select rows observer))
                    (>= ownA reservedA) (>= ownB reservedB)
                    (>= deliveredA 0) (>= deliveredB 0) (>= spentA 0) (>= spentB 0)
                    (>= reservedA (ite (= (holdA before) 1) amountA 0))
                    (>= reservedB (ite (= (holdB before) 1) amountB 0))))
(assert (= (knownB before) 2))
(define-fun after () R (mkrow (decision before) (holdA before) 2 (paidA before) (+ (paidB before) 1) (refundA before) (refundB before) (knownA before) (knownB before) (proofA before) (proofB before) (booking before)))
(define-fun newOwnA () Int (- ownA 0 0))
(define-fun newReservedA () Int (+ (- reservedA (ite (= (holdA before) 1) amountA 0)) (ite (= (holdA after) 1) amountA 0)))
(define-fun newDeliveredA () Int (+ deliveredA 0))
(define-fun newSpentA () Int (+ spentA 0))
(define-fun newOwnB () Int (- ownB amountB 0))
(define-fun newReservedB () Int (+ (- reservedB (ite (= (holdB before) 1) amountB 0)) (ite (= (holdB after) 1) amountB 0)))
(define-fun newDeliveredB () Int (+ deliveredB amountB))
(define-fun newSpentB () Int (+ spentB 0))
(assert (not (and (valid (select (store rows trade after) observer)) (=> (>= (decision before) 2) (= (decision after) (decision before))) (>= newReservedA 0) (>= newOwnA newReservedA) (= (+ newOwnA newDeliveredA newSpentA) (+ ownA deliveredA spentA)) (=> (>= (holdA before) 2) (= (holdA after) (holdA before))) (= 0 (* amountA (- (paidA after) (paidA before)))) (>= newReservedB 0) (>= newOwnB newReservedB) (= (+ newOwnB newDeliveredB newSpentB) (+ ownB deliveredB spentB)) (=> (>= (holdB before) 2) (= (holdB after) (holdB before))) (= amountB (* amountB (- (paidB after) (paidB before)))))))
(check-sat)

(declare-datatypes ((R 0)) (((mkrow (decision Int) (holdA Int) (holdB Int) (paidA Int) (paidB Int) (refundA Int) (refundB Int) (knownA Int) (knownB Int) (proofA Int) (proofB Int) (booking Int)))))

  (=> (= (holdA z) 3) (= (knownA z) 3)) (=> (= (holdB z) 3) (= (knownB z) 3))

  (=> (= (proofA z) 1) (> (holdA z) 0)) (=> (= (proofB z) 1) (> (holdB z) 0))

(define-fun after () R (mkrow 2 (ite localA 2 (holdA before)) (ite localB 2 (holdB before)) (ite localA 1 (paidA before)) (ite localB 1 (paidB before)) (refundA before) (refundB before) (ite localA 2 (knownA before)) (ite localB 2 (knownB before)) (proofA before) (proofB before) (booking before)))

obligations.name: legacy-symbolic-root-alias
obligations.script:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-const n Int)
(declare-const t Int)
(declare-const u Int)
(declare-const p Int)
(declare-const r Int)
(define-fun code ((t Int)(phase Int)) Int (+ (* 10 phase) t))
(assert (and (> n 0) (<= 1 t n) (<= 1 u n) (<= 0 p 6) (<= 0 r 6)
             (= (code t p) (code u r)) (or (not (= t u)) (not (= p r)))))
(check-sat)
